title: ID0395481-DC/Si-D/BR-[jRGFnI] Fan is Constant ON
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  FAN is On
Root cause: LOGO old FW
Solution:  LOGO Updated to v2.7.0
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Active
The customer reported that the fan is on directly, that is, without interruption in the Sicharge D.
Is this behavior normal?
Note: Internal temperature in the panel is below 40°C

additional_info.subject: RE: RES: ID0395481-DC/Si-D/BR-[NULL] Fan is Constant ON CRM:00798001571
additional_info.body:
Hi Joao,
We have investigated the logs over the period of 4w,
We could see the FW version of LOGO PLC is at v2.6.0, We suggest to have FW at latest version i.e. v2.7.0.
You can refer to following link for the FW.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109821347/logo!-fw-v2-7-for-sicharge-d?dti=0&lc=en-IN
We can investigate further once FW is updated. We would check for the Temp and Humidity reading from the respected sensors.
You can reach out to us while on-site.
We need to have multimeter to do troubleshooting.
Do let us know when you are planning for site intervention.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
